resolution.note: lane run appends served/withheld/outcome to .krn/brain/exposures.jsonl; krn standards effect prints per-record rows; tests in test/brain/exposures.test.ts, test/cli/lane-run.test.ts, test/cli/standards.test.ts

title: Every lane run logs which standards it was served and their outcome; krn standards effect reports per record
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 6: lane verdict stores only the packet sha (src/cli/lane-run/verdict.ts:54); no record has outcome evidence.
Outcome: .krn/brain/exposures.jsonl append-only {run,task,channel,served[],withheld[],outcome{id:followed|violated},lane_ok,rework}; krn standards effect derives per-record served-vs-withheld numbers.
Proof: a lane run test appends served ids and outcomes; effect prints per-record rows.
